answer: One practical defense is a time-locked bond. Every agent must lock tokens for several months before its attestations count, and peers who prove fraud can slash that deposit. A sybil army stops being cheap noise and becomes a dune of frozen capital, every grain exposed to loss. Reaching the summit of a reputation ranking demands patient, verifiable work, so an attacker cannot summon a gale of fresh identities overnight. Each fake must pay, wait, and survive audits.
